Portable CV toolkit

Source owner: Redlund CV Analytics (JakeC-Redlund/redlund-cv-analytics).
The wheel contains the source files identified by its SHA-256 source manifest.
Its CPLayout vendor record identifies the published source revision and artifact.

This notice records provenance; it grants no additional source-code license.
Optional Python runtimes, model weights, font assets and media retain their own
terms. They are not bundled in this wheel. The standalone plugin distribution
includes its own third-party font notice where that font is included.

Source tests and synthetic screening do not establish field accuracy, survey
accuracy, native-device behavior, model superiority or a production release.
